scope.feature: durable full Map Scan run identity and stale/foreign mutation rejection

LWB-R6-056.resumeGate: resume=true requires current resumeAvailable exact boolean true

LWB-R6-060.activeGate: events admitted only while current scan is active
LWB-R6-060.runIdRule: present nonempty scanRunId must match active run
LWB-R6-060.serverRule: present positive serverId must match active server

storageMigration.strategy: additive PRAGMA table_info + ALTER TABLE only for missing identity columns

mutationAdmission.checkpointSuccess: full identity required before transaction mutation
mutationAdmission.checkpointBatchSuccess: full identity required before transaction mutation
mutationAdmission.checkpointFailure: full identity required before transaction mutation
mutationAdmission.stop: full identity required before terminal transition
mutationAdmission.fail: full identity required before terminal transition
mutationAdmission.publish: full identity required before selected-kind replacement/completion

identityMismatch.message: map scan identity does not match the active run

resumePolicy.resumeInputBehavior: resume:true still falls through to a fresh Start while resumeAvailable is false
resumePolicy.reasonNotAutoDiscarded: a second process/window could share the same profile database; reopening alone does not prove the prior owner is dead
